verdict.rationale: W&B documents a release support and end-of-life policy for W&B Server: major releases are supported for 12 months and may include deprecations. That gives some product-level version and deprecation guarantees. However, the same evidence says no versioning or deprecation policy specific to the Weave trace HTTP API is documented, and the OpenAPI spec carries no version headers. Missing for 10: explicit API versioning (versioned paths or headers), a deprecation policy specific to the Weave Service API with notice periods, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The W&B release policies page documents release support and end of life
